paper_metadata.title: Microstructure evolution and mechanical properties improvement of (Ti8Zr6Nb4V5Cr4)100-xAlx lightweight high-entropy alloy by Laves phase transformation
paper_metadata.journal: Journal of Iron and Steel Research, International

evidence.quote: (Ti8Zr6Nb4V5Cr4)100-xAlx (x = 0, 0.1, 0.2, 0.3, 0.4 at.%) lightweight high-entropy alloys with different contents of Al were prepared via vacuum non-consumable arc melting method.

evidence.quote: LW-Al0 alloy is composed of two phases, a light grey phase enriched with Ti and Nb (slightly enriched) elements, and a dark grey phase enriched with Zr, Cr, and V.

These four alloys are still composed of two phases, namely, the dark phase enriched by Ti and Nb (slightly enriched) elements and the bright phase enriched by Zr, Cr, and Al (secondarily enriched) elements.
